topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for workload classes, admission decisions, queues, resource budgets, concurrency, priority, cancellations and resource-consumption evidence.

semantics.identity_rule: Workload, operation, execution, queue/admission decision and resource-evidence identities remain distinct.
semantics.semantic_rule: UI distinguishes scheduling/performance controls from canonical operation semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing workload state grants no operation/data/cancel authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Queue/dependency/execution edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Rejected, queued, throttled, timed-out, cancelled and preempted states are surfaced distinctly.

invariants.rule: Admission, quotas, concurrency, priority, cancellation and resource budgets may control when/how work executes but never change canonical query/write semantics, data ownership, classification or authorization.

visual queue order shown as semantic priority
